title: Embedded Linux Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

We develop Torizon, which is a Linux-based industrial IoT platform that simplifies modern iterative development, maintenance, and operation of distributed edge devices. It is a scalable full-stack DevOps-oriented solution, seamlessly integrating device hardware & software (including a Linux OS), development tools, cloud-based remote updates & fleet management, for high reliability and security applications.

Job Description

As an Embedded Linux Engineer, you will be part of the R&D team developing our Torizon OS : an easy-and-ready-to-use Linux-based operating system supported on Toradex hardware and 3rd party hardware.

Your focus will be on maintaining our open source OpenEmbedded/Yocto layers, as well as keeping close contact with the R&D team responsible for maintaining Toradex BSP. You will help maintaining and expanding our automated build and tests to guarantee the high level of quality of Toradex software.

  • Maintain and add support Torizon OS for different SoC platforms (NXP, TI and more to come)
  • Keep close contact with other teams inside R&D to guarantee Toradex’s full stack approach
  • Maintain and expand automated build and test cases for Torizon OS
  • Continuously improve DevOps best practices
Desired Candidate Profile:
  • Mandatory:
    • Experience OpenEmbedded/Yocto and its best practices
    • Experience in Embedded Linux and Embedded Systems
    • Advanced Linux knowledge
    • Intermediate Docker knowledge
    • Proactive and communicate
  • Nice to have:
    • Contributions to FOSS projects
    • Contributions to Debian
  • Willing to learn:
    • How to debug OS/embedded system/software in various languages
    • Best practices on build automation and test setup (CI/CD, DevOps)
    • Writing automated tests
What we offer:
  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Interested in building your career at Toradex? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email.

O seu dia a dia

  • Realizar as previsões de clima e vento para geração eólica, a partir de modelos de tempo para até 15 dias (GFS, ECMWF) ou modelos de clima até 9 meses (CFSv2, WRF);
  • Desenvolver automações e melhorias em modelos e métodos de previsão climática e previsão de vento usando modelos dinâmicos globais e regionais, associados a métodos de machine learning para aprimoramento (acurácia) da previsão de vento para parque eólicos, ENA para usinas hidrelétricas de grande porte, possibilitando projeções de curto a longo prazo;
  • Participar de estudos técnicos para estender histórico de vento de torres anemométricas de parques em operação, usando dados de reanálise e outros métodos apropriados;
  • Criar indicadores e métodos de cálculo de acurácia de previsões de clima e vento e colaborar com demais áreas nas análises de desvios de geração ou previsão;

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços. Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento. Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Desde el primer día encontrarás una rica cultura global colaborativa donde tus responsabilidades tendrán un impacto directo en la estrategia y el crecimiento de la empresa.

Team Overview

La función principal de un Hunter es prospectar nuevos clientes mediante un estricto trabajo de campo, constantes reuniones cara a cara, llamadas en frío y otros medios que promuevan y generen el interés de clientes potenciales. El Hunter debe planificar y ejecutar estrategias persuasivas para lograr afiliar a las mejores cuentas dentro del mercado y a la vez trabajar de la mano con la gerencia de nivel medio/alto, los jefes de operaciones y el personal del restaurante. Buscamos personas con un amplio conocimiento del mercado y excelentes habilidades de ventas.

Role Responsibilities
  • Prospectar clientes, diagnosticar sus requerimientos y construir una solución de valor para cada uno de ellos.
  • Identificar y colaborar estrechamente con aquellos encargados de toma de decisiones de nuestros socios comerciales.
  • Establecer relaciones comerciales con restaurantes aliados, construyendo y fomentando una relación a largo plazo con mentalidad de ganar-ganar.
  • Realizar informes de progreso semanales y asegurar que los datos sean precisos.
  • Realizar un seguimiento preciso y personalizado con cada cliente.
  • Comprender y apropiarse del objetivo y el propósito de DiDi para mejorar de manera continua el desempeño de la empresa.
  • Cumplir y exceder las expectativas y compromisos de nuestros aliados mediante la prestación de un servicio de excelencia.
  • Elaborar planes de acción y asegurarse de implementarlos y alcanzar los objetivos establecidos.
  • Visitar restaurantes identificando sus necesidades y dando seguimiento a las oportunidades de alianzas para cumplir métricas de desempeño y objetivos de ventas.
Role Qualifications
  • Contar con 2 o más años de experiencia comercial.
  • Organizado, proactivo, competitivo y autónomo; capaz de trabajar con fechas límites claras y orientado al logro de objetivos.
  • Habilidades comprobadas de comunicación oral y escrita, con capacidad de persuadir a otros para aceptar conceptos de servicio/soluciones que pueden diferir de sus perspectivas.
  • Poseer capacidades y flexibilidad para trabajar en un entorno acelerado, y con metas retadoras.
  • Habilidades interpersonales para mantener relaciones de trabajo constructivas, asertivas, colaborativas y cooperativas con clientes internos y externos y organizaciones multifuncionales.
  • Fuertes habilidades de venta, negociación y persistencia para lograr objetivos.
  • Habilidad de prospección de clientes, adquiriendo un conocimiento profundo de las necesidades para diagnosticar sus requerimientos.
  • Excel en nivel intermedio.
EEO Statement
  • Creamos valor para nuestros clientes: nos esforzamos por crear experiencias valiosas para nuestros usuarios en todo lo que hacemos, innovando para entregar experiencias seguras, placenteras y eficientes.
  • Tomamos decisiones basadas en datos y métricas relevantes para guiar el panorama empresarial.
  • Creemos en la colaboración de ganar-ganar: el éxito es un esfuerzo de equipo; ayudamos a nuestros socios y colegas a ganar.
  • Actuamos con integridad: hacemos lo correcto, decimos lo que pensamos y nos escuchamos.
  • Nos esforzamos por mejorar continuamente, aprendiendo de errores y ayudándonos a crecer.
  • Promovemos diversidad e inclusión, y creemos en la igualdad de oportunidades para todos.

Estamos comprometidos con desarrollar equipos diversos e inclusivos.

title: CONFERENTE - CAMPINAS
description:
Job description

Responsável pela conferência e controle de entradas e saídas de produtos no RM, atuar na verificação de mercadorias, garantindo conformidade com os pedidos e padrões de qualidade exigidos, bem como realizar a movimentação eficiente e segura de paletes e mercadorias, utilizando transpaleteiras para carregar, descarregar e organizar produtos conforme os procedimentos estabelecidos, visando agilidade e precisão no armazenamento de mercadorias.

Main responsibilities
  • Conferência de Mercadorias: Receber e conferir as mercadorias entregues pelos fornecedores, comparando com as notas fiscais e pedidos, verificando a integridade dos produtos, checando avarias, falta ou excesso de itens;
  • Controle de Qualidade: Inspecionar a qualidade dos produtos, assegurando que atendam aos padrões de segurança e qualidade estabelecidos, registrar e reportar produtos fora do padrão, coordenando ações para devoluções ou ajustes necessários;
  • Registro e Documentação: Atualizar e manter registros precisos de todas as entradas e saídas de mercadorias no sistema, garantindo a documentação correta para processos de auditoria e controle de estoque;
  • Organização e Armazenagem: Garantir o correto armazenamento dos produtos de acordo com as especificações de temperatura e outros requisitos, organizar o estoque de maneira eficiente para facilitar o acesso e a gestão dos produtos;
  • Comunicação: Colaborar com as equipes de compras, vendas e estoque para garantir o alinhamento dos processos logísticos, comunicar-se com fornecedores e transportadoras para resolver eventuais problemas de entrega ou discrepâncias;
  • Segurança e Normas: Assegurar que todas as atividades estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança alimentar e regulamentos legais, cumprir com boas práticas de higiene e segurança no ambiente de trabalho;
  • Realizar a movimentação eficiente e segura de paletes e mercadorias dentro do centro de distribuição, utilizando transpaleteiras para carregar, descarregar e organizar produtos conforme os procedimentos estabelecidos, visando agilidade e precisão no armazenamento de mercadorias;
  • Inspeção e Manutenção: Realizar inspeções diárias nas transpaleteiras e reportar qualquer defeito ou necessidade de manutenção ao supervisor, seguir os procedimentos de manutenção preventiva para garantir o bom funcionamento dos equipamentos;
  • Armazenagem e Organização: Organizar os produtos de acordo com o layout do armazém e os procedimentos estabelecidos, garantindo a disposição adequada e o acesso fácil aos itens; manter a área de trabalho e os corredores livres de obstruções e perigos;
  • Segurança: Cumprir com todas as normas de segurança e regulamentos aplicáveis ao trabalho em centros de distribuição, utilizar equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e seguir as diretrizes de segurança para prevenir acidentes e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro;
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros membros da equipe para garantir a eficiência das operações, comunicar-se com supervisores e colegas para resolver problemas e otimizar processos.
Requirements and skills
  • Ensino médio completo. Cursos técnicos ou superiores em Logística, Administração ou áreas relacionadas são um diferencial.
  • Experiência prévia em conferência de mercadorias e controle de estoque, preferencialmente no setor de alimentos.
  • Experiência com transpaleteiras manuais e/ou elétricas.
  • Certificação para operar transpaleteiras de acordo com a legislação.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de estoque e ferramentas de informática (Excel, software de gestão).
  • Boa capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado e sob pressão;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidades interpessoais;
  • Organização;
  • Pontualidade e assiduidade;
  • Produtividade;
  • Prontidão e iniciativa;
  • Respeito às normas e regras;
  • Trabalho em equipe.
Additional information

Local de trabalho: 100% presencial.

Benefícios:

  • Refeição no local;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Descontos em Instituições de Ensino para graduação, pós e cursos de extensão;

VENHA FAZER PARTE DO NOSSO TIME!! Somos a Anhanguera Ferramentas, uma empresa cem por cento brasileira que atua no setor de MRO (Manutenção, Reparo e Operação) há mais de 25 anos. Começamos nossas atividades na cidade de Campinas no interior de São Paulo. O Gerente de Segurança Patrimonial é responsável por desenvolver, implementar e supervisionar estratégias de proteção física e patrimonial da empresa, e do centro de distribuição, garantindo a integridade de colaboradores, ativos и instalações.   • Relacionamento com autoridades: manter comunicação ativa com órgãos públicos e privados de segurança, visando cooperação e alinhamento estratégico.

title: Sr. BD Hunter
description:
Company Overview

DiDi es la plataforma de tecnología de movilidad más grande del mundo. Con más de 10 años en el mercado, somos la empresa líder en servicios basados en aplicaciones para transporte inteligente, entrega de alimentos y servicios de pago. Haciendo la vida mejor y más fácil para las personas todos los días.

Cuando te unes a Didi, vas a formar parte de una comunidad abierta, inclusiva y diversa de más de 12,000 empleados en todo el mundo. Desde el primer día encontrará una rica cultura global colaborativa donde sus responsabilidades tendrán un impacto directo en la estrategia y el crecimiento de la empresa.

Team Overview

La función principal de un Hunter es prospectar nuevos clientes mediante un estricto trabajo de campo, constantes reuniones cara a cara, llamadas en frío y otros medios que promuevan y generen el interés de clientes potenciales. El Hunter debe planificar y ejecutar estrategias persuasivas para lograr afiliar a las mejores cuentas dentro del mercado y a la vez trabajar de la mano con la gerencia de nivel medio / alto, los jefes de operaciones y el personal del restaurante. Por esto buscamos personas con un amplio conocimiento del mercado y excelentes habilidades de ventas.

Role Responsibilities
  • Prospectar clientes, diagnosticar sus requerimientos y construir una solución de valor para cada uno de ellos.
  • Identificar y colaborar estrechamente con aquellos encargados de toma de decisiones de nuestros socios comerciales.
  • Establecer relaciones comerciales con restaurantes aliados, construyendo y fomentando una relación a largo plazo y con una mentalidad gana-gana.
  • Realizar informes de progreso semanales y asegurar que los datos sean precisos.
  • Realizar un seguimiento preciso y personalizado con cada cliente.
  • Comprender y apropiarse del objetivo y el propósito de DiDi para mejorar de manera continua el desempeño de la empresa.
  • Cumplir y exceder las expectativas y compromisos de nuestros aliados, mediante la prestación de un servicio de excelencia.
  • Elaborar planes de acción y asegurarse de implementarlos y alcanzar los objetivos establecidos.
  • Visitar restaurantes identificando sus necesidades y dando seguimiento las oportunidades de alianzas para cumplir métricas de desempeño y objetivos de ventas.
Role Qualifications
  • Contar con 2 o más años de experiencia comercial.
  • Organizado, proactivo, competitivo y autónomo; capaz de trabajar con fechas límites claras y orientado al logro de objetivos.
  • Habilidades comprobadas de comunicación oral y escrita, con capacidad de persuadir a otros para que acepten conceptos de servicio/solución que pueden diferir de sus persepectivas.
  • Poseer capacidades y flexibilidad para trabajar en un entornr acelerado, y con metas retadoras.
  • Habilidades interpersonales: debe tener la capacidad de mantener relaciones de trabajo constructitvas, asertivas, colaborativas y cooperativas con clientes internos y externos y organizaciones multifuncionales.
  • Fuertes habilidades de venta, negociación, y persistencia para lograr objetivos.
  • Habilidad de prospección de clientes, adquiriendo un conocimiento profundo de las necesidades para diagnosticar sus requerimientos.
  • Excel Intermedio.
EEO Statement
  • Creamos valor para nuestros clientes: nos esforzamos por crear siempre experiencias valiosas para nuestros usuarios en todo lo que hacemos. Nuestro enfoque es siempre innovar nuevas experiencias que sean seguras, placenteras y eficientes.
  • Nos basamos en los datos: creemos firmemente en tomar decisiones informadas, por eso nos basamos en los datos. Podemos navegar mejor por el panorama empresarial estratégicamente mediante el análisis de métricas valiosas.
  • Creemos en la colaboración de ganar-ganar: el éxito es un deporte de equipo. Cuando trabajamos para ayudar a nuestros socios y
  • los compañeros ganan, nosotros también ganan. Mientras nos preocupamos por los mejores intereses de todos, nos comunicamos con franqueza y ejecutamos con excelencia en todo lo que hacemos.
  • Creemos en la integridad: la integridad es el núcleo de nuestro negocio. Somos personas que siempre queremos hacer lo correcto. Nuestras intenciones son sinceras, decimos lo que pensamos y nos escuchamos unos a otros.
  • Siempre nos esforzamos por hacerlo mejor. Eso significa aventurarse más allá de nuestras zonas de confort, aprender de nuestros errores y ayudarnos a crecer unos a otros.
  • Creemos en la diversidad y la inclusión: la diversidad es una de nuestras mayores fortalezas. Nuestras diferencias son las que nos hacen distintos. Nos respetamos y creemos en la igualdad de oportunidades para todos.

Estamos comprometidos con desarrollar equipos diversos e inclusivos

En DiDi creemos que nuestras diferencias son nuestra mayor fortaleza. Es por eso que estamos comprometidos con crear y promover igualdad de oportunidades para todos los empleados.

Las decisiones de empleo y desarrollo en DiDi, siempre se basan en las necesidades de la posición y habilidades del candidato. No discriminamos a ningún empleado o aplicarte por raza, edad, sexo, genero, orientación sexual, nacionalidad, estado civil, embarazo, raza, religión o cualquier otro estado protegido por las leyes aplicables donde operamos.

Estamos comprometidos con desarrollar equipos diversos e inclusivos, además de un espacio de trabajo libre de discriminación, es así como creamos mejores productos y servicios, tomamos mejores decisiones y servimos a la comunidad de la cual somos parte.

Job description

HOSPITAL CARE

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

title: SENIOR DATA SCIENTIST (31939)
description:
Overview

Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro por meio das inovações tecnológicas de alta qualidade e de serviços que despertam entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. Temos uma promessa sólida para nossos colaboradores: crescemos juntos, gostamos do nosso trabalho e inspiramos uns aos outros. Junte-se a nós e sinta a diferença.

Descrição da vaga

The LA AI & Data Center of Excellence seeks a highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Scientist to join our team. This role focuses on developing and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, emphasizing automation, software engineering best practices, and production-ready code. This role requires proficiency in Python programming and experience with various machine learning, deep learning, generative and agentic AI.

The successful candidate will work on projects across diverse business units, directly impacting critical decision-making and driving innovation.

You will lead the development of intelligent systems with a strong emphasis on software and AI engineering best practices, automation, and continuous delivery.

Qualificações

Experience and knowledge (Mandatory):

  • Strong experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering roles, demonstrating a history of delivering impactful AI solutions.
  • Expert-level Python programming, including Pandas, Polars, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and experience with RESTful API development. Experience with Flask/FastAPI for API development is a plus.
  • Strong software engineering foundation: Version control (Git), unit testing, CI/CD pipelines, Clean Code principles, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of programming logic and object-oriented programming (OOP) principles to design modular, reusable, and maintainable code structures.
  • Proven experience in end-to-end ML lifecycle: data preparation, model training, tuning, inference, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
  • Data handling expertise: Extraction, cleaning, transformation, and loading (ETL) from various sources (relational and non-relational databases, cloud storage, APIs). Experience with SQL, NoSQL and vector databases.
  • Machine Learning & Deep Learning: Supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, including regression, classification, clustering, time series, and NLP.
  • Natural Language Processing (NLP): Experience with text preprocessing, pre-trained models (BERT, Roberta), fine-tuning, and NLP libraries (scikit-learn, spaCy, NLTK, Gensim).
  • Experience with Generative AI (e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG pipelines).
  • Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred), GCP or AWS, including their respective AI/ML services (e.g., Azure AI services).
  • Strong understanding of model evaluation, feature engineering, and hyperparameter tuning.

Experience and knowledge (Desirable):

  • Machine Learning & Deep Learning: Computer Vision.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-agent systems and autonomous AI agents (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, LangFlow), including the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Familiarity with data engineering: experience with data warehousing, and big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, Databricks).
  • Experience with MLOps tools and practices: MLFlow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps.
  • Experience working with knowledge graphs and graph-based data representations, including tools like Neo4j, RDF, SPARQL, Stardog or graph neural networks for reasoning and relationship modeling.
  • Domain knowledge (e.g.: experience in industry, laws, HR, marketing, etc.).
  • Ability to assess the business impact and profitability of AI models, including cost-benefit analysis, ROI estimation, and value tracking post-deployment.
  • Ph.D. in a relevant field.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, or Physics.
  • Personality and working method: team player, problem-solving, analytical thinking, pro-active, self-taught, and resilient.
  • Strong communication & collaboration: ability to translate technical insights into accessible information for diverse audiences. Proven ability to work effectively in agile, cross-functional teams.
  • Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with AI advancements.
  • Languages: Portuguese (Brazilian) and fluent in English. German is a plus.

title: Manual QA Engineer
description:
Who we are:

We are a leader in fraud prevention and AML compliance. Our platform uses device intelligence, behavior biometrics, machine learning, and AI to stop fraud before it happens. Today, over 300 banks, retailers, and fintechs worldwide use Sardine to stop identity fraud, payment fraud, account takeovers, and social engineering scams. We have raised $145M from world‑class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Activant, Visa, Experian, FIS, and Google Ventures.

Our culture:
  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, and Toronto. However, we maintain a remote‑first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere
  • We hire talented, self‑motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get‑together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.
Location:
  • Remote - Brazil
    • São Paulo: São Paulo, Campinas, São José dos Campos
    • Rio de Janeiro: Rio de Janeiro
    • Minas Gerais: Belo Horizonte
    • Paraná: Curitiba
    • Santa Catarina: Florianópolis
About this role:

We are looking for a Manual QA Engineer who is passionate about delivering high‑quality, reliable software. You will be responsible for testing and validating device intelligence and security mechanisms across our mobile and web applications. You will apply your experience and knowledge to transform requirements into actionable test plans and detailed test cases. This work will also result in reports and metrics, allowing us to improve continuously. In addition, you will have ownership over the quality of significant deliverables and will collaborate with multiple engineers and teams to drive success.

What you'll be doing:
  • Create detailed, comprehensive, and well‑structured test plans, test cases, and reports on device trust, fraud detection, and secure user behavior.
  • Perform manual testing across a variety of real devices, simulators/emulators, including rooted/jailbroken environments, VPN/proxy simulations, and mobile SDK integrations.
  • Validate security and device intelligence features by working closely with multiple engineers and teams.
  • Implement and maintain test cases inside Testmo or similar test management tools.
  • Identify, record, and thoroughly document bugs.
  • Use tools like Charles Proxy, ADB, Xcode, and Crashlytics to support exploratory testing, debugging, and log analysis.
  • Promote a culture of quality throughout the organization as a quality champion.
  • Track quality assurance metrics and continuously seek improvements.
  • While the primary focus will be on manual testing, you will be expected to contribute to Mobile Automated testing over time using tools like Appium (WebdriverIO, NodeJS).
What you'll bring:
  • 4+ years of experience in manual testing, with a strong focus on mobile and web applications.
  • Strong ability to review product requirements and design, and translate them into effective test plans and cases.
  • Solid understanding of device intelligence, security testing, and threat vectors like jailbreak, VPN, emulator detection, and location spoofing.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Burp Suite, Charles Proxy, ADB, and Xcode Instruments.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to detail and a security‑first mindset.
  • Experience with CI/CD processes and agile environments.
  • Exposure to mobile automation frameworks such as Appium (WebdriverIO, Node.js), or XCUITest — or a strong interest in learning them.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript is a plus.
  • Experience testing pure API products (headless) is a plus.
  • Software development experience is a plus.
Benefits we offer:
  • Generous compensation in cash and equity.
  • Early exercise for all options, including pre‑vested.
  • Work from anywhere: Remote‑first Culture.
  • Flexible paid time off, Year‑end break, Self‑care days off.
  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents – US and Canada specific.
  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP – US and Canada specific.
  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door.
  • One‑time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.
  • Monthly meal stipend.
  • Monthly social meet‑up stipend.
  • Annual health and wellness stipend.
  • Annual Learning stipend.
  • Unlimited access to an expert financial advisory.

Join a fast‑growing company with world‑class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.

To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice.

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:
The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school's mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.
Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.
ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:
Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC's mission and values.
Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.
Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.
Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:
Instructional Support and Student Learning
Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.
Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.
Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.
Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.
Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.
Student Care and Learning Environment
Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.
Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).
Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.
Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.
Operational and School Support
Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.
Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.
Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.
Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.
Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.
Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.
Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.
Professional Conduct and Growth
Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.
Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.
Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.
Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.
Additional Responsibilities
Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school's commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.
Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.
Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.
Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.
Working Conditions
Walk on paths and rough terrain
Lifting backpacks and school materials
Other duties, as assigned.
POSITION REQUIREMENTS:
Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
Five years experience working with children, preferred
PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
English level required: B2 or above
Portuguese level required: B2 or above
Other Skills (Desirable):
Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
Strong professional organization skills
Child Safeguarding
Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.
EAC's Statement of Diversity and Inclusion
EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

#Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models; design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts; replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code; optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed; measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week; decreased cycle time; reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.g., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ; Postgres/Redis; REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends; write clean, testable code; and deploy via CI/CD to a major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics; you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity; you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.g., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.g., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.io/Cloudflare + Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful; evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer
description:
Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js)

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with at least 5 years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with GraphQL.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and UI scaffolding to ensure an optimal user experience.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI and full-stack engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders of Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities operate and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Work closely with UI/UX designers to build, implement, and maintain scalable front-end applications, ensuring delivery of unparalleled user experiences
  • Architecture : Lead front-end architectural decisions, implementing best practices in performance optimization and responsive design
  • Leadership : Provide leadership within the development team, fostering a learning and growth environment
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments utilizing React.js
  • Experience with GraphQL
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience with Python, Golang, Node.js, or Java
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)
description:
Location: On-Site position based in the UAE (Full Relocation Package)


A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.


Position Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team’s products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.

  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.


Preferred Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.

  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Pharmacy Benefits Manager (PBM) experience is a plus.


What You Get:

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team;
  • Unlimited PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule;
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work.


This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals.

Diferenciais

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

-Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e atuar como um mentor técnico, disseminando a cultura de performance para toda a equipe de Front-End.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Hard Skills)


• Proficiência em: HTML semântico, CSS (incluindo pré-processadores ou CSS-in-JS) e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3), Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


• Foco em Resultados: Orientação clara para melhorias mensuráveis (KPIs) de performance e SEO.

• Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas que atravessam múltiplas camadas (navegador, rede, servidor, código).

• Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar problemas técnicos complexos e as soluções propostas para audiências não técnicas (marketing, gestão).

• Aprendizado Contínuo: Manter-se atualizado com as constantes mudanças nos algoritmos de busca e nas tecnologias de otimização web.


Diferenciais

• Experiência com SSR (Server-Side Rendering) ou SSG (Static Site Generation) usando frameworks como Next.js ou Nuxt.js.

• Conhecimento de PWA (Progressive Web Apps) e estratégias offline-first.

Experiência em plataformas de Cloud Computing (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) para otimizar o deployment e a entrega.

title: Senior Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
XILO , a fast-growing Vertical AI company recently backed by a Series A financing round, is seeking a talented and visionary Product Designer with a strong command of user interface design to elevate the intuitive nature and value of our SaaS platform through innovative designs rooted in customer feedback.


About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design process, working closely with engineers and other stakeholders to deliver high-fidelity, implementation-ready designs ahead of schedulethat are directly aligned with customer needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes using Figma that effectively communicate design concepts 2 sprints ahead of engineering timelines.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent and visually compelling UI across the entire platform.
  • Leverage data pipelines to inform and enhance design decisions.
  • Ensure all current products are intuitive and self-servicing for users.
  • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.


What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.
  • Highly tech-savvy and comfortable designing for complex systems.
  • A deep, almost spiritual design philosophy that prioritizes the customer experience.
  • Skilled in conducting customer interviews and synthesizing insights into actionable designs.
  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).
  • No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and collaboration.

- Inglês Intermediário.


Qual localidade?

São José do Rio Preto/SP.


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Country Operations Manager
description:
Country Operations Manager – LATAM

Location: Brazil/ Remote

About Trantor Inc

Trantor Inc. is a global technology services and consulting company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with delivery centers across the USA, Canada, and India. We partner with Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises to drive digital transformation through Product Engineering, Cloud Enablement, Data & AI Solutions, Automation, and Customer Success Services. At Trantor, we thrive in a collaborative, agile, and people-first environment.



Why Join Trantor?

Trantor offers the opportunity to work on diverse, cutting-edge projects in a culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote role while contributing to impactful initiatives in a truly global organization.



About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused, with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth. The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

The right candidate will have proven experience in managing, scaling, and setting up IT/Tech teams, ensuring smooth delivery and operational excellence. They must be adept at building and inspiring high-performing teams, driving compliance and retention, and cultivating trusted long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.


What’s Exciting About This Role?

  • Lead and shape our entire LATAM operation, with the autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing, multicultural team while forging strong client relationships.
  • Play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and market presence.
  • Work in a fast-paced, global environment where your ideas are implemented, not just discussed.



Key Responsibilities


, HR & Resource Management

  • Oversee all LATAM resources to ensure productivity and quality.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.


Tech Operations Oversight

  • Manage and scale tech operations and delivery teams .
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Provide credible oversight in technical discussions with clients.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers across LATAM.
  • Act as the primary liaison for client needs, service delivery, and customer success.
  • Represent the company at local and regional events, forums, and client meetings.


Operational Leadership & Strategic Growth

  • Lead daily operations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and alignment with corporate policies.
  • Collaborate with HR, Finance, and global teams for seamless cross-functional workflows.
  • Monitor performance metrics and provide regular updates to regional/global leadership.
  • Adapt and execute market-specific strategies aligned with global objectives.


Financial & Market Insight Contribution

  • Support budget planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
  • Provide local market intelligence to inform global strategic decisions.



Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 8–12 years in senior leadership or country management, preferably in the IT/Consulting sector.
  • People & HR Management: Proven success in leading teams, driving workforce planning, employee engagement, HR processes, and HR compliance , with measurable improvement in retention.
  • Tech Operations Oversight: Demonstrated ability to set up, scale, and manage IT/Tech teams (Must Have)
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Strong track record in building trusted relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strategic & Operational Skills: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable operational and delivery plans, while ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; Spanish and Portuguese proficiency are strong advantages.
  • Technical Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems, business management platforms, and performance reporting tools.



Why Join Us?

  • Strategic leadership role with direct impact on our LATAM operations
  • Competitive remuneration (salary only)
  • Work within a global and fast-growing organization
  • Friendly, supportive, positive, and professional team of experts
  • Multicultural and diverse environment
  • Full-time employment
  • Remote work conditions

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:

You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale.   • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience

  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

title: Sustaining Engineer

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . Why TARGAN?

Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

  • Familiaridade com conceitos de transformação digital, TICs, Big Data, software, IoT, e-commerce e marketing digital.

O que oferecemos? Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
